snippets.snippet: 2024 SHEFFIELD TOWNSHIP ZONING GUIDELINES The complete Sheffield Township Zoning text is available at the library and on the township website: Sheffieldtwpash.com. The zoning inspector shall keep records of all applications for zoning certifications and the action thereof. Before constructing, locating, changing the use of, or including accessory buildings or changing the use of any premises, altering any building, an application shall be made to the township zoning inspector for a zoning certificate. The application shall include the exact location of the proposed construction, alteration or change of use and shall include a plot plan, plans and specifications showing the proposed use, all of which shall be included in the permanent record of the application. All signs to be kept in good repair under the jurisdiction of the zoning inspector or this permit may be revoked. Also, any additional inspections made by the zoning inspector shall be charged to the applicant at the rate of $15.00 per inspection. This resolution shall not be interpreted as interfering with abrogating or annulling any ordinance, regulations, resolutions or permits previously adopted or issued by the Sheffield Township Trustees. Where such ordinance, regulations or permits are in conflict with this resolution, amendments, thereto, in which this resolutions or amendment, there shall prevail.
